# kernel family — fallback-only + host-only: no distro fingerprint at this
# root, so detection yields nothing and the plan falls back to AllLinuxPlugins,
# which is exactly the path a kernel-bearing firmware root takes in production.
#
# Fixture provenance (google/osv-scalibr testdata, Apache-2.0):
#   lib/modules/.../intel_oaktrail.ko — extractor/filesystem/os/kernel/module/testdata/valid
#     (a real .ko; version read from its ELF .modinfo section)
#   boot/vmlinuz-6.8.0-49-generic — first 32 KiB of
#     extractor/filesystem/os/kernel/vmlinuz/testdata/valid (binclass-style
#     slice; the bzImage header magic and version string sit in the first pages)
#
# scalibr's kernel extractors set no PURLType, so these packages carry no purl
# (and therefore no cpe) — the SBOM records them as name/version components.
# Asserted via "pkg <name>@<version>" instead of "purl".
pkg intel_oaktrail@0.4ac1
pkg Linux Kernel@6.8.0-49-generic
